question: Explain why the spectrum of an atom is a line spectrum and not a continuous spectrum.

options.A: Atomic spectra are continuous because atoms emit every wavelength.
options.B: Atomic spectra are line spectra because atoms emit no radiation.
options.C: Atomic spectra are continuous because electron energy can vary continuously.
options.D: Atoms emit or absorb radiation only at certain definite frequencies. Each frequency corresponds to a definite wavelength, so the spectrum consists of separate lines rather than a continuous distribution.
